title: India Wins Gold & Silver Medals at Asian Junior Weightlifting Championships in Tashkent
summary: Tomchou Meetei won Gold (266kg) and Gurunaidu Sanapathi won Silver (265kg) in Men's 60kg at Asian Junior Weightlifting.
